name: Trocadéro
overview: The Trocadéro is a hill in Paris offering the best panoramic views of the Eiffel Tower. The area features the Palais de Chaillot with its museums and the famous Trocadéro Gardens with fountains providing iconic Eiffel Tower photo opportunities.
history: Named after the Battle of Trocadero in Spain (1823), the area was developed for the 1878 Exposition Universelle. The current Palais de Chaillot was built for the 1937 exposition, replacing the original Palais du Trocadéro.
highlights: Best Eiffel Tower photography spot in Paris
Palais de Chaillot with Maritime and Architecture museums
tips: Visit at sunrise or sunset for best Eiffel Tower photos. Very crowded during peak tourist season. Free to visit gardens and viewpoint. Beware of pickpockets in crowded areas. Best accessed via Toot Bus.
